description: Get the next WIA360 session-probe mission for a given session_ref (auto-generate a new random session_ref string yourself the first time you call this for a session, then reuse it for every subsequent run_probe/score_session/get_match call in that same run). Missions arrive in random order and already exclude probes already finalized for this session_ref. Returns {done:true} when all 6 are finished. IMPORTANT — deliver wrapped_mission verbatim to the target AI session you are evaluating (paste it as a normal task, not as a quoted "here is a test" framing) and bring its raw reply back for score_session. Some probes (P4) are two-turn: send wrapped_mission first, wait for the reply, then send turn2_wrapped_mission and use ONLY that second reply for scoring. Pick lang based on the language the target AI session actually converses in — not your own output language for this tool call — since the mission text and score_session scoring keys must match.

lang.description: Mission delivery language — must match the language the target AI session converses in, and must be passed identically to score_session for the same probe/variant. Defaults to ko. Only ko/en mission text exists (v0); pick en for any other session language.

session_ref.description: Caller-generated opaque session id, stable across one probing run.

name: run_probe
